scope: Entropy-tail law (v6 Theorem 13.2) in the observable rare-event experiment: universal two-sided comparison with the selection functional for every law on (0,1/2], 0 < rho <= 1/4 and B > 0, the separate upper and lower halves, hard selections, the elementary bounds, the single-atom and small-budget values and nonvacuity.
